test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Change the following sentence from passive to active:

By whom were the candidates shortlisted for the interview?

options.text: Who had shortlisted the candidates for the interview?
Who shortlisted the candidates for the interview?
Had anyone shortlisted the candidates for the interview?
Who has shortlisted the candidates for the interview?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Who shortlisted the candidates for the interview?"
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the candidates" at the beginning.
